name: Ivosidenib (IDH1 inhibitor)

institution.provenance: DRAFT decision-support protocol authored from standard guidelines (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

supportiveCare: Differentiation-syndrome vigilance: start corticosteroids and supportive care promptly if suspected; monitor for leukocytosis.
monitoring: QT interval (baseline and periodic; avoid other QT-prolonging drugs).
CBC and signs of differentiation syndrome.

drugs.name: Ivosidenib
drugs.notes: 500 mg PO once daily, continuously, for IDH1-mutated AML (monotherapy, or combined with azacitidine as a separate agent). Avoid with strong CYP3A inhibitors/inducers. Standard Guidelines (NCCN) / DeVita, general reference.
